title: Final Time Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the time interval t' between the reception of the pulses must be derived as tau' = tau sqrt((1 + beta)/(1 - beta)).

title: Doppler Effect Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The relationship for the longitudinal Doppler effect must be correctly expressed as lambda' = lambda sqrt((1 + beta)/(1 - beta)).

title: First Order Shift
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the first order Doppler shift must be correctly derived as Delta lambda_1 = lambda beta.

title: Second Order Shift
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the second order Doppler shift must be correctly derived as Delta lambda_2 = (1/2) lambda beta^2.

title: Velocity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of beta from the proton energy must be correctly applied as beta = sqrt(2E/mc^2).

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for wavelengths and energy.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include sign mistakes in the expressions for time and wavelength shifts.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors such as gamma in the time transformation can lead to incorrect results.
